name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Frost goes with exactly one of Chemistry, Jonah, or Debate.

English, Geography, and Music go with Ellis, Debate, and Robotics, in some order.
English goes with at least one of Frost or Robotics.
Boyd goes with at least one of Iris or Robotics.
